question: The older dialogs, Instagram and Flickr: size, tabs, rows, how each closes, and what is bound to an account.

tock.kind: a plain panel, not a dialog

closes: A press on an empty part of the section beside the dialog closes it, on all nine: one press at 1300, 578 on a 1600 by 1000 window, where the frame's fluid-engine grid was on top and no block, link, button or field. The dialog goes, the block stays and is no longer selected. Save was on before, from the new block, and still on after. Inside the dialog there is no button, no Cancel and no X. Escape leaves it open, and so does a press on its own block.

Instagram.why: the menu connects an outside account. Without one, the Items slider changes nothing. Aspect Ratio, Crop Images and Open Links in New Window do change the block.

Flickr.why: the same as Instagram. Aspect Ratio, Crop Images, Show Title and Open Links in New Window change the block.

Bandsintown.why: Band Name looks up an outside service. Timeframe to Show (Upcoming, Date Range) is named and was not pressed: the walk stops at a field that can reach outside.

SoundCloud.why: its only row is an outside URL. Not typed in.

Tock.why: a sign-up for an outside service. Not pressed.

siteContentBound.Calendar: its only row says there are no collections
siteContentBound.Page Link: help and Learn more only with no page to pick
siteContentBound.Tag Cloud: says there are no collections, yet Display Type, Sort By and the Tags slider change the block

notRead: Instagram and Flickr layout pictures (Slideshow, Carousel, Grid, Stacked): the reader takes them as headings, not controls, so nothing pressed them
Chart Type options beyond a press to Line Chart: Pie Chart named, not pressed
a dialog when a collection or account exists
answer: Nine dialogs, 300 to 572 wide. Chart has three tabs, Instagram and Flickr two, the others none. None has a way out inside it; a press on the empty section beside it closes each.
pressed: Add Block, Edit, each dialog tab, the rows in each CAP-ROWS file, Escape, and a press on the block by its id. Nothing typed in a field that can reach outside. On a probe page, unsaved. Left by a reload. Then one press, not by name, on the empty section beside each dialog.

closePress.where: 1300, 578: the section grid beside the dialog, seen on a screenshot first
closePress.save: on before and after on all nine; on because a new block was added. Probe pages read 0 sections after Exit Without Saving.
